reviews.title: Fairly easy to install hitch. Just remember nothing is exactly Square.
reviews.body: This hitch was fairly easy to install. First what I did was to remove a hold down from the driver's side of the vehicle. Then using one of the bolts from that hold down I was able to clean the threads from the pre-made holes in the bottom of the frame. Next I used a couple of jack stands to hold the hitch in position. The Next Step I did was to attached people into the center hole right behind the back bumper for the center mount. I did not tighten it. Then I was able to install the six bolts that mount the hitch to the side frames. Next before tightening any of the bolts I removed the center mount both and installed a nut for a spacer to take up the space. Then I tightened the three bolts on each side that mounted the hitch to the frame. The final thing was to tighten the two bolts and the center part of the hitch to the frame. See attached pictures. It took me about 45 minutes. It did have good directions except I needed to use an 18 mm socket for the bolts supplied.

reviews.title: Save original hardware and have other hardware on hand!
reviews.body: The grille itself fits well and looks good HOWEVER It’s hard to believe that this thing does not come with ANY hardware. In addition, the top has the bolts pre-installed (but you’ll need to use the factory nuts from your OEM grille) but the bottom has nothing but holes for hardware to be installed. Let’s face it, this grille is a replacement for a grille on a truck that has some age to it so the original parts are likely rusted as mine were. Because the original hardware was rusted I had to cut off some of the nuts and bolts so re-using them was not an option. I did have some of my own hardware to complete the top installation however there really isn’t a great way to use nuts and bolts for the middle and lower portions because those bolts and pre installed on the factory grille and locked into place so when tightening them you don’t have to hold the other end (which is inside the grille mounting bracket). Because of this fact, using regular nuts and bolts isn’t really an option because you have no way to hold the end that goes through the grille when tightening. Due to this I decided to use zip ties as some have mentioned. They held great and although I wasn’t happy about using them they work just fine. Lastly, delivery on this product took awhile, not what you’re used to when buying with Amazon. Overall the grille is a nice upgrade and I may have given it 5 stars if it came with all of the hardware needed to do the installation right.

reviews.body: Didn't have a problem with these TLAPS LED Dinamica Headlights. Half the price as Alphaowls, which I had ordered and had problems with. Tip for owner's of F150 with out factory DRL, run a T-fuse to fuse box under the hood to a ignition fuse ( one that's hot only when the vehicle is running ) Fues # 77 is what I used. 52-54 and 75-78 are all ignition fuses. By the way the brown wire on the TLAPS LED Dinamica Headlights is the DRL. Whatever you do, Do Not Disconnect The Positive Post To Install, Doing so will cause dinamica turn signal not to work properly. If you have problems with your blinker light not working properly, plug your old OEM lights back up. Reconnect Positive Post Remove Key From Ignition wait an hour or so and reinstall LED lights with positive post connected. Hope you enjoy your TLAPS LED Dinamica Headlights as much as I do.
